questions.question: Explain why Lourdes is an important place of pilgrimage for Catholics.
questions.correctAnswer: Lourdes is important because the Virgin Mary appeared to Bernadette Soubirous there in 1858. Mary revealed a spring of water that is believed to have healing properties — the Church has officially recognised 70 miraculous cures. questions.question: "Pilgrimage is a waste of time and money." Evaluate this statement.
questions.correctAnswer: Some argue pilgrimage is wasteful because the money spent on travel could help the poor, and God can be worshipped anywhere (Matthew 18:20). However, Christians who go on pilgrimage say it deepens their faith in ways that ordinary worship cannot — visiting sacred places connects them to Christian history and the experiences of other believers.
